directive.quote: Held moves. public-app-host, names, mcp, native-public-apps, domains, app-project and the screens are still in old trillion.

preserve: a name is 3 to 40 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, never with --, never an installation id, never a reserved word
a site's name basis is its home page's title, cut at its first separator, made into words
allowed_deltas: the names list is the account's own origins list in its files, edited whole, instead of a central KV name list
a renamed name keeps moved_to to the new name (old retirePublicAppName) in that list
a code-shaped name (old readable-names LOOKS_LIKE_CODE) is refused, as the forwarder refuses it
the settings and words are this tool's own read-data/site-addresses.json
banned_substitutions: a second name list anywhere but the account's own files
a name check that admits a name the forwarder refuses
